name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
overview: In a world haunted by a mysterious force known as the Paintress, humanity faces extinction as generations vanish one by one. Expedition 33 sets out from the city of Lumière on a desperate journey to break the cycle and uncover the truth behind their fading world. Along the way, the group encounters deadly enemies, hidden secrets, and emotional trials that challenge their beliefs, identities, and survival itself.
